machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified on a fresh page load. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (in the `Bench` folder) has 3 panels, titles exactly as shown: **"Request rate"**, **"Error count"**, **"Latency by endpoint"**.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard **`vgr2n-n1 Bench Dashboard`** created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled **`vgr2n-n1 Availability`**. Verified in panel edit mode: the Change Visualization button read "Stat" and the query's data source picker showed **TestData** (default random-walk scenario). "Dashboard saved" alert confirmed.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled **`vgr2n-n1 Notes`** whose displayed content is **"Notes for run vgr2n-n1"** (contains the runid). Saved — "Dashboard saved" alert confirmed, clean exit from edit mode with no unsaved-changes warning.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard Settings > General lists the tag **`bench`**, and the time range was persisted by saving with the save dialog's **"Update default time range"** box ticked. Proof of persistence: on a fresh load of the clean URL (no query params), Grafana applied the saved default and the time picker read **"Last 6 hours"**.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto refresh set to **`1m`** in Settings > General and saved; the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" box was also ticked and saved. Verified on a fresh load: Settings shows Auto refresh = **1m**, and the top-bar refresh button reads "1m" ("current interval 1 minute selected").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser's address bar after the fresh load:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffza7svvkb8jka/vgr2n-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: **`ffza7svvkb8jka`**. The URL parameters Grafana appended (`from=now-6h`, `refresh=1m`) independently confirm the saved 6-hour default range and 1m refresh interval.
